name: Citi Strata Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers, then 18.74% to 28.74% variable based on creditworthiness. Cash advance APR 29.99% variable; penalty APR up to 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: Fee for foreign purchases is 3% of the U.S. dollar amount of each purchase.

base_rate.description: 1 point per dollar on all other purchases.

categories.label: Hotels, car rentals and attractions booked on cititravel.com
Gas and EV charging stations and select transit
One self-select category (fitness clubs, select streaming, live entertainment, cosmetic stores/barber shops/hair salons, or pet supply stores)

rewards.redemption_notes: ThankYou Points can be redeemed for gift cards, cash back, shopping with points, Citi Travel bookings, or transferred to partners such as American Airlines, JetBlue and Virgin Atlantic.

signup_bonus.description: 20,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 in the first 3 months.

notes: The product page lists Mastercard ID Theft Protection, establishing the Mastercard network. Pricing comes from the Pricing Details block on the product page. network_tier is recorded as none because the official page does not name the network package.
